kmvhxv0oj1s.title: Vine Lab, space for tuning the vine parameters, marking them good or bad

kmvmftuf02.title: Godot MCP/Harness-editor bridge, for harness to read godot's errors and develop in a human editable way

kl8wc72htc.title: Contract 2: what is the challenge?
kl8wc72htc.body: The gear run lands on a storm planet and retrieves lost gear from the hive's centre, but once the bike is found the player can fly straight to space, so there is no tension. What must the player do to get the gear out, and what stops the bike being an exit? `decisions/0051`.

kkcmx4m73h.title: What unlocks persistent tiers in the full game?
kkcmx4m73h.body: Tiers persist across the campaign (0052); what earns them is not settled.

kfa162mwc4.title: Special-weapon charge counts
kfa162mwc4.body: How many charges a consumable super weapon (nuke designator, orbital laser, atomic grenade, missiles) is found with.

kwa2vh9z7o.title: Kill thresholds for later company drops
kwa2vh9z7o.body: The bike drops at 20,000 kills in contract 3; other thresholds and the order of drops are open.

k65ytmv1dl.title: Do company drops draw the horde?
k65ytmv1dl.body: Whether a package landing attracts cucumbers.

k3oa6g0cpw.title: Scouting tools
k3oa6g0cpw.body: What the player scouts a nest with before dropping, if anything.

k6v2sjemf2.title: Hit-stop tuning
k6v2sjemf2.body: The juice around kills and big blasts; design for it from the start.

kff7za0av0.title: The mineral's name
kff7za0av0.body: Each planet holds a valuable mineral; it is still unnamed.

kml9imjgve.title: How are upgrades bought while in debt?
kml9imjgve.body: Unsolved once the parked debt story is built: the player always owes the company, yet the shop sells upgrades. `docs/ideas/story.md`.

klmo8l3onm.title: The endings
klmo8l3onm.body: Accept the company's renewal and get a mech, or turn on the company by unleashing the horde on it. A direction only. `docs/ideas/story.md`.

k1vd1q3xyi.title: Bike ammo counts and laser cooldown
k1vd1q3xyi.body: The bike keeps its gun, rocket pod, bomb bay and laser, each on limited ammo. The numbers for its stats resource are not set (the laser fires 10 s then cools in contract 2).

kl9rcr1vo3.title: Does the colony ever go back to sleep?
kl9rcr1vo3.body: Today it does not (0041). Also open: a rifle round on bare ground near the nest wakes nothing, and a new `EventBus` signal would need a record.

k72dwqyj6z.title: Rocket balance
k72dwqyj6z.body: One bazooka load killing 7,000-8,000 may be a lack of pressure on the player rather than a kill-count problem. Rockets stay plentiful, because they are the fun.

khjt201qcp.title: Fear-scatter after blasts
khjt201qcp.body: Scared cucumbers scattering after big blasts so the player must herd them back. Wanted, not implemented.

k05uey0g4m.title: Separable body pieces on kills
k05uey0g4m.body: Pieces flying off with stylised splatter. A cucumber is one shader-drawn capsule with no separable parts; measure the cost on Iris Xe first.

kpd82p6o02.title: Early pacing: Cornichons first
kpd82p6o02.body: Thrown Cornichons arrive before the bigger types, so early fights feel like mowing down small fry. Revisit.

km62th47jp.title: Tanks defending a damaged vine
km62th47jp.body: Tanks rushing to guard a hit vine in a tight radius. Under 0041 harm wakes everything, so a local guard has nothing to add yet.

k6mc11blm6.title: Debt as the story spine
k6mc11blm6.body: The player owes the company; deaths and failures add to it with a cap; the balance prints on every invoice. Parked until the slice is played. `docs/ideas/story.md`.

kf62a4w1k2.title: Show, don't tell: cold invoice wording
kf62a4w1k2.body: Invoice words grow colder across the campaign, from specimens to units to biomass. No young cucumbers; no corpse-carrying.

k0i9ga4nx3.title: The recurring rival contractor
k0i9ga4nx3.body: A scripted boss with one visible counter per return (flares, cutting vines), who bails out instead of dying and takes your paycheck. Stay apart from the Nemesis system.

khwtlwqlfd.title: Root hearts that wither nest sections
khwtlwqlfd.body: Killing a root heart withers a whole section of the nest.

kvukayqwo3.title: Mid-mission company bonus jobs
kvukayqwo3.body: Optional jobs offered during a contract.

khesmahnmy.title: Mother Brine as a roaming boss
khesmahnmy.body: Climbing out of the main shaft as a town-contract climax. Cut from the slice.

kkdqajmp2j.title: A buried queen and caves
kkdqajmp2j.body: A queen too big to leave her cave, setting up a follow-up nest contract. Mole cucumbers and the underground queen are full-game.

k2eemu6t9y.title: Player-called airstrike with a handheld designator
k2eemu6t9y.body: An orbital cannon or airstrike the player calls.

kta68592k0.title: Magic weapons
kta68592k0.body: A staff that works as a spell conduit. Kept out of the slice.

klydozrgv6.title: Detailed ballistics and wound channels
klydozrgv6.body: To be checked against the brine-not-blood tone.

kvlvwzvsyv.title: A small cast of recurring rival characters

kh6eedubdh.title: Remove the prototype weapons outside the five
kh6eedubdh.body: Noted, not started (decided: do not change the weapons yet). `wpn_bayou_boomstick`, `_machete`, `_brine_burner`, `_brine_ripper`, `_dill_hammer`, `_frag_grenade`, `_gherkin_volley`, `_gravity_manipulator`, `_grenade_thrower`, `_sledge`, `_strike_designator`, `_vinegar_lance` are in the player's code and the `arsenal` and `slam` benches. Removal edits the player and those benches. Replaced by 0052's five.

ktmpclw08s.title: Five core weapons, tiers 1 and 2
ktmpclw08s.body: Assault rifle (piercing, underbarrel launcher), bazooka (four-rocket volley, bigger rockets), pole saw (reach, spin; no ammo), laser cannon (shorter cooldown, wider beam; gravity-gun mode), sniper (.50, explosive rounds, airstrike). `decisions/0052`.

kmebgtn62g.title: Viewmodels for the five weapons
kmebgtn62g.body: Assault rifle with underbarrel launcher, bazooka, pole saw, laser cannon, .50 sniper.

k655vhwsq6.title: Weapon wheel and aim on every weapon
k655vhwsq6.body: Mouse wheel switches weapons; right mouse button aims on every one; five slots with free choice.

kjpsoklvxg.title: Specials and the consumables bar
kjpsoklvxg.body: Reusable specials (minigun, fire rocket launcher) and consumable super weapons (nuke designator, orbital laser, atomic grenade, missiles); a separate bar for grenades, medkits, shield generators, ammo.

ktqdjlumun.title: Nuke designator
ktqdjlumun.body: Marks a spot; the player flies clear before it lands. One-off prompt that fades if ignored. Needs the nuke blast.

k8zjkihlkf.title: Minigun special (the gift at 50%)
k8zjkihlkf.body: Armour-piercing minigun, given by the company at 50% of the nest destroyed in contract 1.

kcdoh8dnqc.title: Six-tier upgrades and the shop
kcdoh8dnqc.body: Ammo, ammo, mod, mod, secondary ability, its evolution. The slice shows both tiers of every weapon but pays for two purchases in total, and logs every purchase.

ksunprparv.title: Log every shop purchase
ksunprparv.body: To learn which upgrades people want.

kfwgdeu8lg.title: Ship cabin hub
kfwgdeu8lg.body: Walkable cabin, a window onto the next planet, ambience. Failure wakes the player here, unpaid.

kgc0b5h3gc.title: Invoice printer
kgc0b5h3gc.body: Prints the itemised invoice (fee minus ammo, clones, damage, rentals) and stamps it PAID.

k6opukibwo.title: Crate hatch
k6opukibwo.body: The purchase arrives in a crate through a hatch.

ks1n6bad80.title: Main menu as a live window on the ship
ks1n6bad80.body: The planet rotating slowly, ambience, a periodic beep. Play, Options, Wishlist on Steam, Join Discord, Send feedback, Credits, Quit.

knxwfv1ao7.title: End of the slice: empty contract screen
knxwfv1ao7.body: Ends on an empty contract screen with a wishlist-on-Steam line; any contract can be replayed after.

kglsls194t.title: Opening sequence: unclear cloning flashes
kglsls194t.body: Short, deliberately unclear, shown once and never explained. `decisions/0054`.

kwz3q32m1f.title: Landing pod and the descent through the window
kwz3q32m1f.body: Control inside the pod, look around, watch stars, sun, atmosphere and clouds; the door opens onto the vines. Every contract arrival. Landing in a town smashes the pod through skyscrapers.

kpn1sitphx.title: Replay the cloning flashes at the first death
kpn1sitphx.body: At the first death in contract 1 the lab flashes replay as the clone respawns.

ktnv9tjmcr.title: Free drop point on the contract screen
ktnv9tjmcr.body: A rough sketch of the planet and nest; scout far out or drop straight onto the nest; no mandatory setup phase.

k16thyizou.title: Extraction by pod
k16thyizou.body: Call extraction, a pod drops, the ground falls away through the window.

k1g0shpxx2.title: The queen
k1g0shpxx2.body: A stationary pod at the nest's centre: rind that rifle rounds barely mark, weak spots that open after she attacks, feeder vines that heal her until cut, a guard of Tanks and Spitters. Tuned for 2-3 minutes at tier 1, about 25 bazooka hits.

kr0t7utdc6.title: Queen attacks: screech, seed spit, tearing down vines
kr0t7utdc6.body: Screech knocks you off the grapple and calls the horde; sticky seed spit slows you; tearing down vines around her in a growing radius pushes you from minigun to sniper range. Each telegraphed.

kgecybyw9v.title: Contract 1 win and HUD
kgecybyw9v.body: Queen dead, every pod destroyed, at most 20% of cucumbers alive; the HUD marks the last pods.

k8iqngmcmc.title: Contract 1 light tips
k8iqngmcmc.body: Grapple first, then movement and the weapon wheel.

kfbmttm8bb.title: Tank throws and punches
kfbmttm8bb.body: The Thrower is folded into the Tank.

k2fwqgzuoa.title: Targeting: aggro radius and the director
k2fwqgzuoa.body: One flow field to the contract's anchor plus a player aggro radius that allows baiting; the director varies the radius with a telegraph such as a screech.

kii3ahzcvw.title: Death: three clones, failure pays nothing
kii3ahzcvw.body: Three clones a contract, nothing lost on death; losing all three fails the contract and you wake on the ship unpaid, keeping upgrades. `decisions/0053`.

kggy9njlhj.title: Storm planet and weather
kggy9njlhj.body: A second biome in storm season: fog, lightning, dead calm, a tornado that rips up vines. Weather is mood.

k59ppbab5r.title: Contract 2: fixed landing glitch
k59ppbab5r.body: The storm scrambles targeting; the player always lands at one fixed spot at the nest's edge and it must read as intended.

kao9xzqxfc.title: Contract 2: crash pod and beacon
kao9xzqxfc.body: The dead contractor's pod high in the tallest vine at the hive's centre, holding the nuke designator; optional call-in earns the "piece of shit" achievement.

ksqar6vf01.title: Contract 2: tornado climax
ksqar6vf01.body: The storm peaks, a tornado rips up vines; cucumbers flung at you, telegraphed and shootable mid-air.

kmensgaigg.title: Hoverbike as a special item with limited ammo
kmensgaigg.body: Gun, rocket pod, bomb bay and laser on limited ammo. The prize of contract 2; a company drop at 20,000 kills in contract 3.

k74keab5cs.title: Contract 3: procedural town
k74keab5cs.body: One big pad, skyscrapers, a main shaft and side shafts at the edges as spawn holes (no drill rig), 5-6 turrets. About 5,000 cucumbers at landing, ramping toward 24,000 with refill.

k5zbr22nla.title: Contract 3: shafts and sealing
k5zbr22nla.body: Sealing a side shaft with the bazooka or a gravity-gunned fuel tank slows the refill.

k2io49x5mo.title: Contract 3: turrets and roof relays
k2io49x5mo.body: Power relays on skyscraper roofs: grapple up, flip the switch, hold through the spin-up. A collapsed tower cuts that turret's power.

kpahwcifjh.title: Contract 3: shuttles and four targets
kpahwcifjh.body: A shuttle every 4 minutes, five in all: 1-3 ore, 4 takes 80% of the people, 5 the last 20%. Four automatic corner miniguns and a rocket launcher while landed. Three ore sites and the shelter are defended at once.

kw1mwr8uik.title: Contract 3: mech drop and the ending choice
kw1mwr8uik.body: A mech drops midway; the end is a choice between boarding shuttle 5 at once and defending the last 20% until they board.

kyctx0noal.title: Company drops inside a contract
kyctx0noal.body: Physical pickups with loaned support: fighter and tank mechs, and the laser hoverbike at the top tier.

kfs7ip2y4a.title: Plain health bar and shield; strip pickle-themed names
kfs7ip2y4a.body: Replace the jar HUD, *PICKLED!* and the brine-named weapons. `decisions/0050`.

k97i3fjzx1.title: Cucumber faces: scared and angry
k97i3fjzx1.body: Near-tier expression via a per-agent input or a few baked variants; benched. Brine, not blood.

kumj8wt02i.title: Whimpers and wails
kumj8wt02i.body: Heard in the quiet before the alarm and at close kills; `AudioDirector` caps and pools them.

krhuc8u7x4.title: Verify Blender .glb facing and scale
krhuc8u7x4.body: Take a test asset through the pipeline and replace the two "not yet verified" lines in CLAUDE.md.

knc2cn1ft9.title: Model the queen
knc2cn1ft9.body: Rind plates, weak-spot hatches (emissive), seed-spit mouth, feeder roots; voxel and destructible.

kd51jqhjy9.title: Model the landing pod interior and ship cabin
kd51jqhjy9.body: Pod seat, window and door; the cabin with invoice printer and crate hatch; cloning-lab glimpses.

klxvfmdvsz.title: Model the armed shuttle and colony set
klxvfmdvsz.body: Shuttle with corner miniguns; skyscrapers, the armoured shelter, ore storage, shafts, turrets, relays, fuel tanks, security mechs.

kjy6sdopu0.title: Model the crash pod, storm planet and nuke blast
kjy6sdopu0.body: The contractor's crash pod, the storm biome and tornado, and the staged planet-scale blast.

kkdli86jpq.title: First-person hands
kkdli86jpq.body: The one rigged thing; late on purpose.

kphsdpdm3e.title: Repository, Godot project, Jolt and Git LFS
kphsdpdm3e.body: Godot 4.7.2 mono, `net8.0`, Jolt set explicitly, LFS from the first commit (0003).

kkfpifx2ja.title: Player and the grapple
kkfpifx2ja.body: Zip, swing, orbit and release float; jetpack hover and dashes.

kd4qf91hjp.title: The horde at 25,000
kd4qf91hjp.body: Flat arrays, simulation tiers, density cap and view cull; blasts and beams reach the crowd. Allies are attacked and bitten (0012).

k4wu0xt1p2.title: Voxel destruction
k4wu0xt1p2.body: Every voxel model breaks the same way (0011); off the frame (0015); rubble stays (0016, 0022); chunk graph and building collapse (0027); trees hold by connection (0024).

kyacll279v.title: MagicaVoxel importer
kyacll279v.body: `.vox` imported directly: parts, colour per vertex, emission, markers (0009).

kwdmo9pqen.title: The planet
kwdmo9pqen.body: Cube-sphere at the origin, streaming, craters, sites (0017); seeded planets and biomes (0018); the session and loading screen (0021); pinned at 1,260 m (0037).

k9b4szlp6x.title: Vulkan renderer
k9b4szlp6x.body: As fast idle and faster under the horde than D3D12 (0048).

k5lubvjgqg.title: Vine nest grown at load
k5lubvjgqg.body: Seeded, 25 s at 25,000; saved nests are presets (0033); only valid vines (0036); one clump, 55-70 m apart (0038).

k561rkmbxd.title: Plants bend; leaves are meshes
k561rkmbxd.body: Spine of springs, collision that follows, wind and the grapple push (0032, 0035); vines leave no rubble (0042).

kvb4m7m4rn.title: Pods in bulk and regrowth
kvb4m7m4rn.body: One pod per cucumber in flat arrays, drawn instanced and bent on the GPU (0040); regrow until destroyed; the win rule (0034).

kzyq060ft3.title: The colony wakes on harm
kzyq060ft3.body: Never on nearness; every cucumber drops into the horde over 30 s (0041).

k09w2avhfp.title: The Vines tool
k09w2avhfp.body: Nest tab, range lab, Good/Bad training logs (0043).

kxh43w0rbi.title: The editor bridge
kxh43w0rbi.body: Claude works in the running editor, every change one undo; own terrain brushes (0044).

kn2caa0emx.title: Mechs fight on broken
kn2caa0emx.body: Procedural gait, only core or head kills, mend themselves, Blender moves baked to data (0046).

kroina331z.title: The asset lab
kroina331z.body: One place to look at, tune and break any asset, in the editor and in play (0047).

k9wtn2beyi.title: Gamepad
k9wtn2beyi.body: One layout on the same actions (0025).

kfx25738dg.title: Onboarding level
kfx25738dg.body: `lvl_nest_intro` on a saved 1,000-cucumber nest, with landmarks and prompts (0049).

kmvux337z1.title: Fire. Fire spreading through a dense nest is chaos that runs itself, and it can burn you too.
